moves.text: Offer jsous: Hunter Henry + Mike Gesicki for Colston Loveland.

reasons: You're 5-1 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 12%.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 4th of 11 contenders (143.5 points a week).
Your weakest position is QB (7th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 4th in 2026, 4th in 2027 and 4th in 2028 (title chances about 12%, 15%, 15%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.

That trade raises your title chance from 12% to 16%, and your lineup comes out 3.8 points a week ahead overall. Hunter Henry + Mike Gesicki add 1.8 points a week for you today, but Colston Loveland is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 5,260, get 5,480), and it barely changes their lineup (-0.4 a week).
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 15% and 15% to 21% and 16%.
You have 7 weeks until the trade deadline.
